description:
The Gulf Craft Majesty 48 is a comfortable flybridge yacht for up to 12 guests, based in Abu Dhabi and ideal for island hopping, a family outing or a sunset cruise. Charters start from 4 hours, the right length to explore the islands off the Abu Dhabi coast.

The saloon and its U-shaped sofa open onto the aft deck, where a table is set for lunch on the water. Upstairs, the flybridge offers a lounge and sunbeds, and the bow cushions are perfect for sunbathing.

Below deck, two cabins with double beds allow guests to rest during the charter. Water toys such as a jet ski or a banana ride can be added on request.

Contact Yacht Research for availability and a tailored quote.
